# oko

> A lightweight Android and Android TV app for streaming movies, TV shows, and live TV via CircleFTP on BDIX networks.

oko is a free, open-source CircleFTP streaming client built for BDIX networks in Bangladesh. It provides direct access to local FTP media servers without the overhead of a web browser.

## Key Features
- Streams movies, TV shows, and live TV from BDIX CircleFTP servers
- Works on Android phones (5.0+) and Android TV (4.4.4+)
- Lightweight and fast with no ads
- Multi-source support for different BDIX servers
- D-Pad navigation optimized for TV

- Download (TV): https://github.com/mahidsec/oko/releases/latest/download/oko-tv.apk
- Source code: https://github.com/mahidsec/oko
- Privacy Policy: https://mahidsec.github.io/oko/privacy-policy/
oko connects to CircleFTP servers available on BDIX (Bangladesh Domestic Internet Exchange) networks. Users must be connected to a supported BDIX ISP to access content. The app discovers available media servers on the local network and presents them in a clean interface for browsing and streaming.
